definitions.short: a girding on (of the ephod); hence, generally, a plating (of metal)
definitions.full: H642. aphuddah אֲפֻדָּה noun feminine ephod (= אֵפוֺד , for which it supplies construct & suffix forms). 1 of high-priest's ephod , compare אֵפוֺד 1b , only אֲפֻדָּתוֺ חֵשֶׁב Exod 28:8 ; 39:5 the cunningly-wrought band of his ephod. 2 of sheathing of idol-images , מַסֵּכַתוְהָכֶ֑ךָ אֲפֻדַּת Isa 30:22 (|| ךָ כַסְמֶּ פְסִילֵי צִפוּי ) compare אֵפוֺר 3a.
